tools.name: cpv_search
tools.description: Resolve free-text to CPV codes (the EU Common Procurement Vocabulary used to classify tenders). Returns matching codes with Polish labels. Use the codes with list_tenders filter='category' (division = first 8 digits). Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

tools.name: cpv_tree
tools.description: Walk the CPV hierarchy. Omit `parent` for top-level divisions; pass a code, with or without the check digit (e.g. '45000000-7' or '45000000'), to list its children. Each node flags whether it has children. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

tools.name: cpv_labels
tools.description: Resolve CPV codes to their Polish labels. Pass an array of codes, with or without the check digit (e.g. ['45000000-7', '79952000']); each label comes with the full code. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tenders" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Semantic search over active Polish public tenders (przetargi) by meaning, with optional filters. Ranks by relevance (hybrid vector + keyword). Returns paginated tender cards, each with a public URL. Only publicly-servable tenders with an AI summary are returned. `mode` is 'semantic', or 'lexical' wh" → after: "Search active Polish public tenders (przetargi) by keywords — the same search as the tender list in Przetargowy Janusz: a tender matches when it contains every word of the query, in any inflection, in its title or contracting authority (the whole query also in CPV and description); words like 'dla' "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
